Name: Yuta Okkotsu
Author: PhantomJoker69
Description: You like Yuta Okkotsu? You like Jujutsu Kaisen? Well, you'll like this mod! Yuta currently doesn't have a lot going on right now, he has 2 different schedules everyday but thats all he has and he currently has 0 heart events, but as soon as I figure out how to add those, trust me, he'll get them! He does also work with any other mod you may have at your disposal! (Atleast I hope so!) (Spritesheet used was from the Yuji itadori mod by mod creator: YujiHat)!
